description: Add navigation links (Home, Hello World, Privacy) to the Navbar component

userStories.title: Add navigation links to Navbar component
userStories.description: As a user, I want navigation links for Home, Hello World, and Privacy in the navbar so that I can reach these pages easily.
acceptanceCriteria: Import `Link` from `react-router-dom` in src/components/Navbar.jsx if not already present
Add `<Link to="/">Home</Link>` `<Link to="/hello">Hello World</Link>` and `<Link to="/privacy">Privacy</Link>` inside the <nav> element
Maintain existing styling conventions for the nav and links
Save the file without introducing lint or type errors
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
